hint.label: Theocracy
hint.text: A theocracy is a type of government that is ruled by religious leaders and has laws based on religious ideas.

atoms.b: Ajaws were the leaders of Maya civilisation and acted as rulers, ((++priests chefs)) and warriors all at the same time. This is a system of ((++government farming)) called a theocracy.
atoms.sound: Adjaws were the leaders of Maya civilisation and acted as rulers, priests and warriors all at the same time. This is a system of government called a theocracy.

atoms.b: The role of leader was passed down from father to ((++son dog)).

feedback.finish: The priests were very important because they knew about astronomy and the Maya calendar. They organised religious rituals in temples to preserve spiritual beliefs.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The nobles and warriors had very specific roles in society. While the nobles looked after the administrative business in the city, the warriors protected the land.
The lower class families paid taxes called tributes to the upper classes to support them and the upkeep of the city.

atoms.a: What were the two roles of this class?
What were the taxes of the lower class called?

instruction.text: Select the two lower classes on the pyramid.

feedback.wrong: This class was one of the highest in Maya society.

instruction.text: What roles did ordinary people have in Maya society?

feedback.finish: The ordinary people were mostly villagers who constructed buildings and worked on the land as farmers.

instruction.text: Were enslaved people the lowest class in Maya society?

feedback.finish: Enslaved people were mostly prisoners of war or criminals and had to carry out the most difficult jobs. They were also used for human sacrifices!
